input.plan:
## What's wrong in the current docs

Cross-referenced against the official rules PDF (`Play Moon Princess 100 online _ Casino games _ Shokker.pdf`) and the in-game info screenshots:

- **Wins are described as 4-connected flood-fill clusters.** The actual rule is **line wins**: 3+ identical symbols in a single row or single column, consecutive, no gaps. A symbol can be part of one horizontal AND one vertical win simultaneously, but L-shapes / squares / diagonals do not count. This is the root cause of the bugs the user observed (wilds bridging non-line shapes, sub-3 "wins", different symbols counting as the same — all symptoms of `[combat/scripts/cluster_detector.gd](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/cluster_detector.gd)`'s flood-fill behavior).
- **Wild drop is described as "one wild at the centroid of every resolved cluster."** Actual rule: a wild only appears when a winning line of **exactly 3 symbols** is removed, placed in the **middle cell** of that 3-cell line. 4- and 5-symbol wins do not drop a wild.
- **Multiplier +1 per cluster resolved.** Actual rule: **+1 per cascade drop** (i.e., once per cascade pass, regardless of how many lines resolved that pass).
- **Princess power "automatically triggers when a spin produces zero clusters."** Actual rule: Girl Power is **triggered at random on non-winning spins** (not guaranteed). The active princess **changes after each Girl Power activation** (not after every losing spin). Start princess is random, then fixed cycle Love → Star → Storm.
- **"Current + next princess" UI in §9 of the design doc.** Actual game shows only the **active** princess. The "next" preview is invented and must be removed.
- **Trinity feature is treated only as a goal type.** It is actually a **core meter mechanic**: princess-symbol wins fill a 3-section meter (x3 fills 1 section, x4 fills 2, x5 fills 3; wild can contribute). When full and the cascade ends with no further win, one "Trinity round" runs: multiplier resets, each non-winning drop triggers a Girl Power in fixed order Love → Star → Storm (one per princess, three total). Clearing the grid during this round triggers Free Spins (with no instant clear-grid prize).
- **Free Spins feature is missing.** Player picks a princess (Love=4, Star=5, Storm=8 initial spins). Multiplier carries from Trinity, capped at x100. Chosen Girl Power triggers on every non-winning spin. Trinity cannot trigger; meter fills grant additional spins (Love +4, Star +3, Storm +2), capped at 100 total spins.
- **Clear-grid prize formula incomplete.** Actual: `50 × total bet × active multiplier`, and is suppressed during the Trinity round (which instead triggers Free Spins on grid clear).
- **Paytable values are absent.** Screenshots give exact pays per tier including an "Any princess" mixed-princess line and explicit Wild pays. Useful for the simulator and goal-tuning.
- **RTP listed as 96.20%.** PDF for the version we're modeling lists **94.20%**.
- **Symbol map needs a small note** that princess-symbol wins (AXEL: cigarette/booze/bloody hand) feed the Trinity meter while low-pay symbols (the four "suit" symbols) do not.

## What stays the same

- AXEL framing (combat as dream/intrusion layer), CRT/glitch aesthetic, all of §6–§9 of the design (items, thematic ties, currency, open decisions — except the one wrong open-decision recommendation).
- Symbol reskin (cigarette/booze/bloody hand for the three princess premiums; satanic mark for wild; the four suit symbols).
- Encounter/goal taxonomy from §5; Trinity stays as a goal but is also re-anchored as a real mechanic the goal hooks into.
- Hook system, item examples, phased build order.

## Edits to `[AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_design.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_design.md)`

**§3 "Moon Princess 100 — base mechanics"** — rewrite:

- Replace cluster wording with line wording. New bullet: *Win rule: 3+ identical symbols connected horizontally OR vertically in a single row/column, no gaps. A symbol may participate in one horizontal and one vertical win at once. The wild substitutes for any symbol.*
- *Cascade: winning symbols are removed; remaining symbols fall; new symbols drop in.*
- *Wild drop: only when a winning line of exactly 3 symbols resolves; placed in the middle cell of that 3-cell line. 4- and 5-symbol wins do not drop a wild.*
- *Multiplier: starts at x1 and increases by +1 on every cascade drop. No upper cap during the base game (cap of x100 applies during Free Spins).*
- *Three princesses: only the active princess is shown. Girl Power triggers at random on non-winning spins. After each activation, the active princess changes in the fixed order Love → Star → Storm. The starting princess is randomized.*
  - Love: converts one set of symbols (all instances of one symbol type) into another symbol type.
  - Star: adds 1–2 wilds at "intelligent" positions.
  - Storm: removes two sets of symbols from the grid.
- *Trinity meter: princess-symbol wins fill a 3-section meter (x3=+1 section, x4=+2, x5=+3). Wilds inside princess wins still count. When the meter completes and the cascade ends with no further win, a Trinity round runs: multiplier resets; each non-winning drop triggers a Girl Power in fixed order Love → Star → Storm (one per princess). Active princess on exit reverts to the one shown before Trinity.*
- *Free Spins: triggered only by a grid clear during the Trinity round (no instant prize given). Player chooses one princess (Love 4 / Star 5 / Storm 8 initial spins). Multiplier carries from Trinity, capped at x100. Chosen Girl Power triggers on every non-winning spin. Trinity cannot retrigger inside Free Spins; meter fills grant extra spins (Love +4 / Star +3 / Storm +2) up to a hard 100-spin cap.*
- *Clear-grid prize: 50 × total bet × active multiplier. Suppressed during Trinity (where grid clear triggers Free Spins instead).*
- *RTP 94.20%, high volatility, max win 15,000× stake.*

Add a new sub-table under §4 listing the paytable values from the screenshots (Princesses 16/1.60/0.48, Any princess 8/0.80/0.32, Bell + Heart 4.80/0.48/0.24, Star + Green 3.20/0.32/0.16, Wild 80/3.20/1.60). Note that "Any princess" wins are mixed-princess lines and pay reduced.

Add a one-liner under §4 that princess-symbol wins (AXEL: cigarette/booze/bloody hand) feed the Trinity meter, while the four low-pay AXEL "suit" symbols do not.

**§5 "Encounter design"** — clarify that the Trinity goal type now hooks the real Trinity meter rather than being a parallel invention. Add a Free-Spins-related goal note (e.g., "Trigger Free Spins" can become a late-act objective).

**§9 "Open decisions"** — replace the "current + next, hidden third" recommendation with "show only the active princess (matches MP100 base game). Optional roguelite item could later expose the next princess."

## Edits to `[AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_implementation.md](AXEL/axel_project/plans/AXEL_combat_implementation.md)`

**§3 "The spin lifecycle"** — replace the cluster wording. New state-machine sketch:

```
IDLE → SPINNING → RESOLVING_LINES → CASCADING → (loop)
     → TRINITY_CHECK (if meter just completed and no further wins)
     → GIRL_POWER (probabilistic, only if no win all cascade and not in Trinity)
     → CLEAR_GRID_PRIZE (if grid empty; suppressed in Trinity)
     → GOAL_CHECK → IDLE / END_ENCOUNTER / ENTER_FREE_SPINS
```

Note: multiplier increments **once per cascade drop**, not per line.

**§4 "Cluster detection"** — rename to **"Line detection"** and replace the algorithm. Replace `cluster_detector.gd` (current 4-connected flood-fill at `[AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/cluster_detector.gd](AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/cluster_detector.gd)`) with a row/column run-length scan:

```gdscript
static func find_lines(cells: Array) -> Array:
    var lines: Array = []
    for r in ROWS:
        _scan_run(cells, lines, Vector2i(0, r), Vector2i(1, 0), COLS)
    for c in COLS:
        _scan_run(cells, lines, Vector2i(c, 0), Vector2i(0, 1), ROWS)
    return lines
# _scan_run walks the line tracking the current symbol_id; wild matches any
# anchor; a run of length >= 3 emits a line {symbol_id, cells, length}.
# The same cell may appear in one horizontal AND one vertical line.
```

Document the wild rule explicitly: a wild matches the active anchor of the run; a pure-wild run pays out as wild (wild has its own paytable entries). Note that the resolve step deduplicates the cell set across overlapping horizontal/vertical lines so each cell is cleared once, but the payout is summed over all lines.

**§6 "Wild placement on resolve"** — rewrite. Wilds spawn only on lines whose `length == 3`, in the middle cell of that 3-cell line. 4/5-length wins do not drop wilds. Centroid logic is removed.

**§7 "Princess rotation + powers"** — rewrite trigger logic:

- A Girl Power is rolled with probability `p_girl_power` (data-driven; placeholder ~0.6 — to tune via the simulator) only on cascade chains that produced **zero** wins, and not while in a Trinity round or pre-Free-Spins choose state.
- The active princess changes only **after** an activation (not on every losing spin). Starting princess is `rng.randi_range(0, 2)`.
- Powers are still Love/Star/Storm; Star adds 1–2 wilds; Storm removes two sets; Love converts one set into another set.

Add new section **§7a "Trinity meter"**:

- New `meter.gd` resource holds `sections_filled: int` (0..3) and the snapshot of the active princess to restore after Trinity.
- On every line resolve, sum princess-symbol contribution: x3 → +1, x4 → +2, x5 → +3 sections; cap at 3.
- When meter == 3 and the cascade chain finishes with no new win, enter Trinity round: reset multiplier to x1; for each subsequent non-winning drop, trigger Girl Power in fixed order Love → Star → Storm; exit after all three. If grid clears during Trinity, transition to Free Spins.
- After exit, `active_princess = saved_princess`.

Add new section **§7b "Free Spins"**:

- New `free_spins.gd` controller with `spins_remaining`, `chosen_princess`, `multiplier_carry`, `multiplier_cap = 100`, and `total_spin_cap = 100`.
- Choose-princess UI gates entry. Initial spins per princess: Love 4 / Star 5 / Storm 8.
- During Free Spins: chosen Girl Power triggers on every non-winning spin (not random). Trinity cannot trigger. Meter fills grant additional spins (Love +4 / Star +3 / Storm +2), respecting `total_spin_cap`.
- Multiplier carries; only resets when Free Spins fully end.

**§2 data model** — add three resources: `MeterState`, `FreeSpinsState`, and a small `PaytableDef` resource carrying the paytable values from the screenshots (and the AXEL reskin value column once finalized).

**§8 "Goals"** — update `GoalTrinity` description: it now succeeds when the player triggers the **real** Trinity round at least once during the encounter. Add an optional `GoalFreeSpins` (trigger Free Spins). Adjust `GoalMultiplierCeiling` note: in base game the multiplier resets between spins; the ceiling refers to peak within a single cascade chain (or to the carried Free-Spins multiplier).

**§10 "UI / renderer"** — remove "active princess portrait + next princess preview"; replace with "active princess portrait + Trinity meter (3 sections)". Add Free-Spins HUD (spins remaining, carry multiplier, chosen princess).

**§12 "Testing plan"** — replace test #1 with "Line detector — canned grids; runs of 3/4/5; gap rejection; wild substitution including pure-wild run; same cell in horizontal + vertical." Add tests for Trinity meter increment math, Trinity round Girl-Power ordering, Free-Spins spin economy and multiplier cap.

**§13 phases** — Phase 1 must produce a deterministic line-based grid (not cluster). Phase 2 splits into 2a (random Girl Power + active-only princess UI) and 2b (Trinity meter + Trinity round). Phase 2c is Free Spins. Goals/items shift one phase later.

**§14 watchpoints** — replace "centroid math on even-sized clusters is ambiguous" with "wild placement on 3-line wins is unambiguous (middle cell); 4/5 wins do not drop wilds — guard against double-spawning if a cell participates in both horizontal and vertical 3-line wins (spawn at most one wild per cleared cell, prefer horizontal-then-vertical resolution order, document the choice)." Add "Trinity round must save and restore the pre-Trinity active princess." Add "Multiplier increments once per cascade drop, not once per line."

## Order of operations

1. Edit `AXEL_combat_design.md` (sections 3, 4, 5, 9, plus the new paytable sub-table).
2. Edit `AXEL_combat_implementation.md` (sections 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, new 7a/7b, 8, 10, 12, 13, 14).
3. Both files only — no code or asset changes in this step. (`cluster_detector.gd` rewrite is described in the doc and queued for a follow-up coding task.)
